_comment: v5r phase 1 (2026-11-24): the v5 phase 1 plan after the v5r warm-up (retry rows from step 1, output pairs in every reading, plan-only call thinking), with a 32,768 token window for sampling, evaluation and round SFT (completions up to 18,432 tokens after a 14,336 token prompt), reading and retry metrics on every round evaluation, and W&B project atpg-v5-retry. Phase 1 of the v5 schedule (scripts/rft/run_schedule.py, schedule_v5_juno_h200.json) on one juno h200 node (2x H200 141GB): RFT rounds with STaR rationalization until val has not risen above the best round for 3 rounds, then GDPO from the best round. start_adapter and run_dir are filled in by the schedule (phase 1: the warm-up SFT; phase 2: the best benchmarked GDPO checkpoint of phase 1). v5 settings: problems are selected per circuit kind and level (kind_shares), prompts up to 14,336 tokens, validation and benchmark split evenly between kinds, rounds ranked by the mean over kind x level. Two GPUs in place of four: an SFT step keeps its 1,024 conversations (2 ranks x 512), and sampling gets twice the hours so a round holds as many problems as planned for the h100 node.

gdpo._gate_comment: User go 2026-11-24: GDPO starts only when the start round's greedy evaluation (8 calls) calls again after at least half of its first-call misses and reads at least half of the missed calls as missed (gate_report scalars). Otherwise the driver exits 3 and records gdpo_blocked.
